additional_info.subject: RE: McqdJC - screensaver and FW update CRM:02023000258
additional_info.body:
Good morning Thomas,
Yes, the picture is uploaded correctly to the screensaver. The screenshot that I showed you is from the remote frontend. From the remote frontend we can operate the charger remotely via ssh, as if from the HMI, and we can see what the frontend sends to the HMI (but strictly speaking, not what the HMI shows). That's because the remote frontend via SSH connection is adapted to the webpage format and dimensions, which are different than the HMI dimensions, hence the screensaver image results to be distorted, but it is only from the remote frontend, not on the HMI.
Hope I provided an answer to your question.
With kind regards,
